NTPC Assistant Executive Online Form 2025 - Complete Details

National Thermal Power Corporation Limited (NTPC) has released the Notification for the recruitment of 400 Assistant Executive Posts through the Its Official Website of NTPC. Candidates Can Also Check All Details on Official Sarkari Result website which is SarkariExam.comFor all the interested and eligible candidates who want to apply for this recruitment can read all the information related to the recruitment is given below and the link to apply is given in the Important Link section below..

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 12 February 2025
  • Application Start Date : 15 February 2025
  • Last Date : 01 March 2025
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 300/-
  • SC, ST, PWD : Rs. 00/-
  • Pay the Examination Fee Through Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking, E Challan
